title.narrative: REDD+ stakeholders at national and provincial level benefitting from training on the Mai-Ndombe-ERP
Beneficiary communities trained on climate change activities in targeted communities in the ERP area
Biennial Emission Reduction Monitoring Reports (ER-MR) of the Mai-Ndombe ER Program submitted and validated by FCPF
BSP Annual Implementation Report implementation approved by the ER Program’s Steering Committee (COPIL)
Satisfaction of target beneficiaries (level of engagement by gender and age per target area
Annual Audit Reports on the National and Provicial levels REDD+ Infrastrucure delivered.
Awareness raising and engagement of stakeholders on the ER Program.
Environmental and Social Safeguards Implementation Annual Reporting of Mai Ndombe ERP submitted to SIS and approved
National REDD+ registry is online and updated with a nominated administrator
Policy and legal analyses on carbon finance frameworks completed
REDD+ Homologation Order (or equivalent for national endorsement of REDD+ projects/programs) is revised and approved
